articles.title: How to use a calculator and share the answer
articles.card: Use a calculator and share the answer
articles.summary: Pick GST, Loan EMI, SIP, HRA, Stamp duty or Margin, type your figures, read the answer at once, then copy a link, print, download for Excel or save it to your data.
faq: Is anything sent to a server?
No. The working happens in your browser. A copied link carries the figures inside the link itself.
Into your Nivesh Sahayak data home (my.niveshsahayak.in), under Saved results on this page.
